evd_title: ChatGPT-human correlation was weakest in intervention and objective CONSORT-A domains r equals 0.02 and 0.06
finding: ChatGPT-human correlation was weakest in intervention and objective CONSORT-A domains r equals 0.02 and 0.06
P: 30 implant-dentistry RCT abstracts (Menne, Pandis & Faggion 2021 SR)
I: ChatGPT GPT-3.5 (no version pin), zero-shot fixed prompt with CONSORT-A item definitions; single run
C: 2 clinician reviewers (consensus >=80%, then one reviewer solo)
O: Per-domain Pearson r: intervention 0.02, objective 0.06 (weakest); highest trial design 0.49, blinding 0.44 (n.s.)
